pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions with moderately sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. The spatial area of individual dark patches significantly exceeds the area of the inter-patch corridors on the central flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes exhibit primarily three-way and four-way intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the lateral flank, narrowing slightly at the anterior neck transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous dark mane along the dorsal neck exhibiting low-amplitude, high-frequency serration forming a jagged 1D silhouette against the sky background.
